body:
I would suggest using a test value with more variation than `Vector3(1, 1, 1)`. If the vector adding were bugged in a way that it always adds other vector's `x` component to other vector's `x`, `y`, `z` components, this test doesn't notice that. So for example `vector_add_assignment += Vector3(1, 11, 111);` would be better. 

Same thing with some other tests, for example `vector_mult_assignment`. If the implementation is bugged and the vector is just multiplied by itself instead of the other vector (which has the same value), current test doesn't notice that.
